findings.text: Even Cyndia, at the Pass with her full company and her careful reports, expected nothing from the south but merchants with the wrong papers and the odd human lordling who took a wrong turn hunting.
findings.deletionTest: Even Cyndia ... expected merchants with the wrong papers out of the south, and the odd human lordling who took a wrong turn hunting. The sentence survives: 'Even' plus the trivial list already carries the low expectation.
findings.reason: Pattern 4 minimizer ('nothing ... but'): it waves away a threat before naming the list. Not a binary diagnostic, spatial correction, world rule, or Sylvanas arguing with herself. It is also the first of four negations in four consecutive sentences in this paragraph (nothing/None/It hadn't/wasn't an army). The other three are self-argument and stay; cutting this one thins the cluster.
findings.textureZone: Inside texture_desert (sentences 151-170) and telegram_run (151-158). The fix adds a comma-joined clause.
findings.suggestedFix: Even Cyndia, at the Pass with her full company and her careful reports, expected merchants with the wrong papers out of the south, and the odd human lordling who took a wrong turn hunting.
findings.crossCheckNotes: Negation: none remain in the sentence. Intent-smear: the subject is still Cyndia, a person. I rejected 'expected the south to send' because it would make geography the actor (P1/P3). Recurring-tics: I rejected 'looked south for' to avoid adding a look/gaze beat (Tic 5 is at its cap of 4). The fix adds no tic words.

findings.text: You didn't circle a stone from Lordaeron. You came and put your hand on it, and nobody felt you cross.
findings.deletionTest: How? You came and put your hand on it, and nobody felt you cross. This survives, and the geography can move into the positive clause ('came north').
findings.reason: Pattern 5 preamble negation ('You didn't X. You Y.'), the same shape as 'She did not laugh. She smiled.' The refused option is not a live choice in the scene. It is scaffolding before the inference the paragraph needs: she must have come in person.
findings.suggestedFix: To circle that one, you came north and put your hand on it, and nobody felt you cross.
findings.crossCheckNotes: Negation: 'nobody felt you cross' is a plain fact. It echoes the runner's and Cyndia's reports and is not a pivot. Intent-smear: the second-person 'you' is the actor and the hand is her instrument, with no body-part agency. Recurring-tics: no tic words. It reads cleanly between 'How?' and 'Or somebody told you which one to circle, and that was worse.'

findings.text: She couldn't even do Sylvanas the courtesy of being a fool in silk.

findings.reason: The sentence names what the mage is not after the paragraph has already said what she is. It repeats the 'fool in silk' contrast from line 271 ('A fool in silk she could have sent home...'). Adversarial self-check 1: deleting it loses no concrete fact. Condition 4 fails because the next sentence ('She stepped into the cell.') does not complicate it.
findings.crossCheckNotes: Deletion only. Nothing new is introduced under any pass A guide. 'without a ripple' at the end of the remaining paragraph is a fact, not a pivot.

audits.secondSweep: Dedicated P5/P6 pass done. Roads and geography carry only spatial verbs ('fell away', 'running down', 'bent', 'dropping', 'climbing', 'went on'), with no fire, revision, or command verbs. Maps, reports, and files receive no cognition verbs; the map is always acted on by Sylvanas, Cyndia, or 'somebody' who pinned or drew it. Body parts: only the involuntary hand closing (lines 145, 207) and palm sensation (lines 75, 235). Abstract-into-body ('defeat settling into his mouth' type): none. Metaphor chains: only the limp/favouring-a-leg family on the stones, one verb family.
